# Salar Ahmed Mirza — AI & Full Stack Engineer

Salar Ahmed Mirza is a Full Stack and AI Automation Engineer based in Islamabad, Pakistan.
He specialises in React.js, FastAPI, Python, LangGraph, and intelligent system design.

Currently working at M3Hive, building RAG pipelines, LLM integrations, and production chatbot systems.

## Projects
- ScaffSmart ERP: Android ERP with YOLOv8 object detection for scaffolding businesses
- Emotion Detection App: CNN-based emotion recognition integrated into a mobile wellness app
- QuickCart: Modular frontend e-commerce platform
- Attendance Management System: Full stack web app with admin panel and report generation

## Skills
